Welcome to The Horse Listener — where you learn to see what your horse has been showing you all along.

I'm Nika Vorster — equine bodyworker, MSc Equine Chiropractic, and guide for Horse Listeners.

Your horse is your mirror  — reflecting exactly what YOU need to change.

If your horse is:
🐎 Showing "mystery" behaviours no expert can explain
🐎 Struggling despite trying everything
🐎 Telling you something's wrong—but no one can find it

I help female riders:
✅ Observe what their horse is reflecting
✅ Ask the right questions
✅ Test different approaches
✅ Adjust based on what the mirror shows

This isn't mystical. It's practical, repeatable, and works with any horse.

Because your horse has been telling you the whole time.

📍 Dubai | Coaching riders worldwide

Join The Horse Listener
https://nikavorster.com/the-horse-listener

Join the Daily Email
https://nikavorster.com/newsletter

Subscribe for horse transformations, bodywork insights, and the truth about what your horse is showing you.
